tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rnam par bkod pa ngo mtshar 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rnam par bkod pa ngo mtshar 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rnam par bkod pa ngo mtshar 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo tsakra saṃ bha ra ya/ dpal ldan sku ni thams cad pa/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sems dpa' po/ /'gro ba'i yid kyi mun 'joms pa'i/ /bla ma rdo rje can zhabs la/ /btud nas dpa' bo lū yi ba'i/ /bzhed don 'jigs pa med pa'i gzhung*/ /ji bzhin sdom pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ /shin tu nyung ngu'i tshig gis brjod/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs 'khrul spong gi don nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems/ rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang skad cig gis he ru ka phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ lte bar ā li kā li g.yon skor du 'khod pa las/ 'khor lo gsum gy-i lho tshogs spros te bgegs thams cad bcom par gyur/ oṃ a ā nas/ ha k+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ / zhes pa nas/ nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma drwa ba can no/ /oṃ suṃ nas/ bha ga bān badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags rnams nag po ljang khu dkar po ser po'i 'od kyi tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa/ 'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams su sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can/ steng du rdo rje'i bla re dang gur/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mda'i drwa ba rnams su gyur/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pas sum+bha tshar gcig brjod/ sngags re re'i 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo ma bzhi/ gnyis gnyis 'dres pa'i 'od zer las byung ba'i mtshams ma bzhi rnams/ tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkugahūm̐/ ra ba'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ 'brub khung ba rnams su bcug/phur bus spyi bor btab/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod/ tho bas brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra sogs/

bgegs rnams bde ba chen po'i dbyings su bsgral/ ra ba la thim/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje dang pad+ma ma dang 'khor lo'i ra ba rim pa gsum gyis skor zhing phyogs thams cad du ye shes kyi me 'bar gyur/ rang gi snying khar lam̐ las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs brjod/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgoms/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i dbus su rang gi lus ngag yid gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ oṃ āḥl thim/ āḥhūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ cha lnga nā da'i bar du thim/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzña na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nā da yang stong par thim/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da dmar skya nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las spros pa'i yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar/ g.yon bskor gyi a āḥ nas/ aṃ aḥnyid 'gyur dang*/ ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ḍa dha/ da dha/ ya la gnyis 'gyur du gnas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ ā li bcu drug dang*/ kā li bzhi bcu nyis 'gyur gyis mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su nam mkha'i nā da yongs su zhugs te/

de las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las ha/ de las zhabs kyu ste/ hūm̐ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs/ tshur dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ bre phul dang*/ gser gyi snam bu dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ bzung ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng du ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sdong bu cung zad bcas pa/ mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phre bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum bcu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phy-i+i rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol/ dur khrod chen po brgyad phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yongs su khyab pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/

rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa rgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ nor bu rin po che dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yon thod khrag dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing*/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi do shal can/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /gnyis ka'ang bskal ba'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lho ru gzugs can ser mo/ thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das ma'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o//thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma/ byang du mahā ka la dang gtum mig ma/ nub tu ka pā la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho ru mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lhor su ra bi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/

lho nub tu 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang du rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar du rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su ang ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ byang du ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ /nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho ru rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma dwe/ lho nub tu rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang du 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ byang shar du mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang paṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub tu rta mgrin dang sna ring ma/ lho nub du nam mkha'i snying po/ snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lhor he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ /lho nub tu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang du rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ byang shar du rdo rje sems pa dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo dang*/ dpa' bo rnams phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ lhag ma dpal he ru ka dang mtshungs shing nyi ma la g.yas brkyang gi gnas pa'o/ /dpa' mo rnams ni rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa las/ g.yas na gri gug 'dzin pa'o/ / shar sgo khwa gdong ma sngon po/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ma/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/

byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni drag mo'i gzugs can ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi cod pan dang ldan pa/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs khar ye shes sems pa he ru ka sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo yab la 'khyud pa/ de'i thugs khar ting nge 'dzin sems pa nyi ma gnas pa'i hūm̐/ yang na snying khar hūm̐ dang*/ lte bar ā li kā li'i 'du 'phro las/ ye shes sems pa bskyed ces gsungs pa ltar/ byas kyang rung ngo*/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bi ra yo ni kā ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ yab yum gnyis ka'i mig gnyis la/ oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa la dza las gzugs rdo rje ma me long 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ rna ba la hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po la hūm̐ las sgra rdo rje ma sngon po pi wang 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ sna la tram̐ las ser sna rdo rje ser po la bam̐ las dri rdo rje ma ser mo dung chos 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ lcer āḥlas 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa la ho las ro rdo rje ma dmar mo ro drug gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ dpral bar ham̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ljang khu la kham̐ las reg rdo rje ma ljang khu nab bza' 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ snying khar hūm̐ las dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po/ rdo rje dkar po 'dzin pa la ram̐ las chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo chos 'byung 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/

de rnams rim pas rnam snang*/ mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ snang mtha'/ don grub/ rdor sems rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa/ yab rnams g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /sgra rdo rje ma ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan can/ gti mug rdo rje zla ba dang gzhan rnams nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /lte bar lam̐ las lhung byed ma ser mo g.yas dang po na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ snying khar bam̐ las gsor byed ma sngon po rdo rje/ mgrin par pam̐ las 'gugs byed ma dmar mo pad+ma spy-i bor tam̐ las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma ljang khu ral gri/ thams cad kyang phyag lhag ma gsum gyis gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gsang bar kham̐ las pad+ma dra ba can ma dud kha/ dud dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug /g.yon gsum na thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rim pas bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥho las rnams las skyes pa'i rnam snang mi bskyod pa/ 'od dpag med/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis yang dag par 'khyud pa/ de thams cad kyang zla ba la gnas pa/ mgo bo gzugs phung bum̐ las rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo 'dzin pa g.yon dkur bsten pa la ltung byed mas 'khyud pa/ lte bar tshor phung am̐ las rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che 'phyar ba/ mgrin par 'du shes kyi phung po hrīḥ las pad+ma gar dbang pad+ma 'phyar ba la 'gug byed mas 'khyud pa/ long bur 'du byed kyi phung po ho las rdo rje rgyal po sngo sangs sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar ba la pad+ma gar dbang mas 'khyud pa/ gsum char phyag g.yon thugs khar sgyings pa/ snying khar rnam shes kyi phung po hūm̐ las rdo rje sems pa dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs khar gtod pa/ g.yon dkur bsten pa dang mtshungs shing*/ dra ba can mas 'khyud pa/ phung po thams cad kyi spyi ni hi las/ he ru ka gnag po rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon can g.yon sgyings pa dang bcas pas dkur bsten pa la/

gsod byed mas 'khyud pa thams cad kyang g.yon dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /snying khar oṃ ha dkar po las rdo rje sems pa/ mgon por na ma hi ser po las rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hūm̐ dmar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su po khad he nag po las mi bskyod pa/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser las rdo rje nyi ma/ lus thams cad la phaṭa ha ྃ ljang khu las rta mchog /lte bar oṃ ba ྃ dmar mo las rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haṃ oṃ sngon po las gshin rje ma/ khar hri ma ྃ dkar mo las rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo las bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu las skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha las tsaṇ+ḍi ka /rdo rje sems pa gnyis dang rmongs byed ma zla ba dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ dkar po las rdo rje nag po/ byā las nor bu byā gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ d+yā las ze'u 'bru d+yā gyis mtshan pa/ lte ba dang*/ snying khar/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying*/ mgrin pa dang mgo bo la yum gyi snying po dang nye snying*/ de bzhin du yum gyi lte ba dang snying khar/ yab kyi snying po dang nye snying*/ mgrin pa dang spyi bor yum gyi snying po dang nye snying phan tshun 'khyud pa dang tshum pas rjes su chags par byas/ thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa spyan drangs/

rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ dbang gi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la mchod par gyur/ rig ma bcu drug gi sngags brjod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes gsung zhing thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dang*/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rin 'byung ngo*/ /thugs 'khor pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor pa la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor pa la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams/ lwa ba bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs sogs dang 'dra la rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags gnyis kyis bstod/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas/ rjes gzhig gi rim pas dkyil 'khor 'od gsal du bsdus la/ slar yang rdzogs par bzhengs bar bya'o// de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni zhes sogs rnal 'byor ma kun spyod bzhin du brjod do/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ ji ltar bzla ba'i tshul/ lū yi par spyi dang mtshungs shing*/ 'on kyang sngags bzla tshul/ kha sbyor gyi bzlas pa ni lugs 'di la mi mdzad pas/ so sor bzlas pa bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas la/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams rang lus kyi gnas so sor thim/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis gsal bar gyur/ spyi bo spyi gtsug rna g.yas ltag pa dang*/ /rna g.yon smin dbus mig dang phrag pa dang*/ /mchan khung nu ma lte ba sna rtse mgrin/

kha dang snying kha 'bras bu mtshan ma dang*/ /bshang lam brla dang byin pa rkang sor bol/ /rkang mtheb pus mo yul chen nyi shur gyur/ /pu dza yo a/ go ra de ma/ ka yo sri pā ka hi/ pre gri so so su na pi ma ku/ /de dag tu gnas pa'i rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /mi phyed phra gzugs rtse mo g.yon/ /thung ngu rul sbal sgom la dbang*/ /skyon ma 'jug ma ma mo mtshan/ /bsil sbyin tsha ba gzhol [ ma ] rangs/ /gzugs can spyi bor rgyu sbyin mang*/ /sbyor bral sdu gu drug ma 'tshed/ /yid bzang gsung 'khor 'dod ma khyim/ / gtum mo rnams la rim bzhin du/ /rab gtum gtum mig 'od ldan sna chen ma/ /brtan blo mi'u thung lang ka shing grib ma/ /sa bsrung 'jigs byed rlung shugs chang 'thung ma/ /sngo sangs shin bzang rta rna bya gdong ma/ /'khor shugs dum skyes chang 'tshong go cha ma/ /rab dpal stobs chen 'khor bsgyur brtson chen ma/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi dpa' bo nyer bzhir gyur pa ni/ /so sen skra spu lpags pa dri ma sha /rus pa rgyus pa mkhal ma snying dang mchin/ /mig 'bras mkhris pa glo ba rgyu ma zhag /lte ba chu so 'dom bar bad kan rnag khrag rdul tshil dang mchil ma snabs/ /rim bzhin thod dum keng rus chen po dang*/ /keng rus mche gtsigs lha dgra 'od dpag med/ /rdo rje 'od dang rdo rje'i sku dang ni/ /myu gu can dang rdo rje ral pa can/ /dpa' chen hūm̐ mdzad rab bzang rdo rje bzang*/ /'jigs chen rta sna stobs chen rin chen dang*/ /rta mgrin mkha' snying khrag 'thung gar dbang phyug /rnam snang rdo rje sems pa rnams su gyur/ kha dang sna g.yon gsang ba sna phug g.yas/ /rna ba g.yas g.yon mig rtsa g.yas g.yon la/ khwa gdong 'ug gdong khyi gdong phag gdong dang*/ /brtan ma pho nya mche gtsigs 'joms ma'o/ /snying mgrin lte ba dpral ba'i 'khor lo la/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma/ / spyi bo gsang bar thig le dkar dmar ni/

/he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mor gyur/ /de ltar lus dkyil la rgyun ring du sems gtad cing sgom mo/ /de nas chos thams cad bde ba chen por lhag par mos te/ go cha gnyis bgos la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /'di nyid kyi rgyun gyi gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ sdom 'byung gi sgrub pa'i thabs su bshad pa de kho nas bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga rdo rje 'phreng ba'am/ /'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas 'byung ba de dag kyang ji ltar 'os pa'i tshe bya'o/ /gal te mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa nyams su len par 'dod na/ phung khams skye mched kyi dag pa bor la ye shes tshogs bsogs pa yan sngar ltar bsgom la/ bsrung 'khor dang dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab/ go cha gnyis bgod pa man chad sngar ltar byas pas 'grub bo/ /shin tu bsdus pa ni rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i 'phreng ba ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar bshad par gyur 'di yang*/ /phun tshogs yon tan tshad med de/ /grub pa'i dga' ston brgya phrag ni/ / blo ldan rnams kyi rtag tu thob/ /slob dpon chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi bzhed pa las 'byung ba'i/ sgrub thabs 'khrul pa spong ba'i lugs ltar/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rnam par bkod pa ngo mtshar 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu pa la gser mdog can gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rnam par bkod pa ngo mtshar 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 356 -- PAGE 355 -- PAGE 345 -
